message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard is a choropleth where fill color encodes the risk index. The legend runs from dark maroon at the bottom (Low, 0) to pale yellow at the top (High, 100). Among the three candidate states, Illinois (IL) is filled pale yellow, placing it near the high end of the scale (approx. 80–100). Kansas (KS) and Delaware (DE) are filled dark maroon, placing them near the low end (approx. 0–20). Therefore, Illinois has the highest risk index among the options.", "option_label": "Open Illinois (IL) risk detail for priority follow-up"}
